content: PromtEngineer/localGPT design_rationale.md (primary): per-table embedder identity marker + normalized flag in Arrow metadata, EmbedderMismatchError on cross-embedder access; motivated because width-only guard silently accepted harrier-0.6b<->Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (both 1024). A/B: harrier-0.6b vs Qwen3-Embedding-4B mixed nDCG@10 0.915 vs 0.875, docs 0.759 vs 0.638, ~3x lower latency ~7x less memory; post-adoption 317 chunks/72 queries nDCG 0.913. bge-reranker-v2-m3 HURT strong first stage: -0.022 mixed/-0.058 docs at +1.6s; Qwen3-Reranker-4B +0.062/+0.173 at +12.7s/7.5GB; 0.6B rejected (noise-band gain, 1.5-2.8x latency); noise floor 1 query ~0.014 nDCG. rerankers lib builds Qwen3ForSequenceClassification with RANDOM score head - must use yes/no logits scheme. Any embedder change forces re-index and re-opens reranker decision.
